style.prompt: Create a wide premium perfume product photograph for a website homepage banner using the supplied product image. Preserve the supplied bottle's exact silhouette, peach-pink glass, silver atomizer and neck charm. Keep the product recognizable and faithful, do not redesign the bottle or add a cap. Place the entire bottle on the right third with comfortable margins above and below; generous uncluttered negative space on the left for a website headline. Elegant realistic studio product photography on a warm ivory seamless background with a very subtle blush gradient, soft directional light, realistic glass refraction and restrained soft contact shadow. Crisp bottle details, refined natural finish. No added text; leave negative space for website headline. No extra bottles, props, logos or invented lettering.
